concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-009 (bootstrap likelihood‑ratio test for regime distinctness reporting p < 0.05) is not mapped to any phase or task in the plan. The plan’s Phase 1 row lists “SC‑009 (log file timestamps)”, which does not satisfy the spec’s SC‑009.

The plan references a Success Criterion “SC‑009 (log file timestamps)”, but SC‑009 does not exist in the specification; the intended criterion is SC‑008. This is an over‑reach / mis‑labeling that should be corrected to refer to SC‑008 or removed.
